mapper.select: select work_id, story_summary, characters, relations, foreshadow, timeline, items, props, style_guide, outline, threads, state_board, date_format(update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as update_time from sys_work_ledger where work_id = #{workId}
mapper.insert: insert into sys_work_ledger (work_id, story_summary, characters, relations, foreshadow, timeline, items, props, style_guide, outline, threads, state_board, create_time, update_time) values (#{workId}, ifnull(#{storySummary}, ''), ifnull(#{characters}, ''), ifnull(#{relations}, ''), ifnull(#{foreshadow}, ''), ifnull(#{timeline}, ''), ifnull(#{items}, ''), ifnull(#{props}, ''), ifnull(#{styleGuide}, ''), ifnull(#{outline}, ''), ifnull(#{threads}, ''), ifnull(#{stateBoard}, ''), now(), now()) on duplicate key update story_summary = coalesce(#{storySummary}, story_summary), characters = coalesce(#{characters}, characters), relations = coalesce(#{relations}, relations), foreshadow = coalesce(#{foreshadow}, foreshadow), timeline = coalesce(#{timeline}, timeline), items = coalesce(#{items}, items), props = coalesce(#{props}, props), style_guide = coalesce(#{styleGuide}, style_guide), outline = coalesce(#{outline}, outline), threads = coalesce(#{threads}, threads), state_board = coalesce(#{stateBoard}, state_board), update_time = now()
mapper.select: select work_id, chapter_meta from sys_work_ledger where work_id = #{workId}
mapper.insert: insert into sys_work_ledger (work_id, chapter_meta) select work_id, json_object(cast(chapter_no as char), cast(#{meta} as json)) from sys_work_chapter where work_id = #{workId} and chapter_id = #{chapterId} and chapter_no = #{chapterNo} on duplicate key update chapter_meta = json_set(coalesce(chapter_meta, json_object()), concat('$."', #{chapterNo}, '"'), cast(#{meta} as json))
